sourceText: In /Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound: the npm script test:autopilot-resume-smoke (packages/main/package.json, possibly mirrored at root package.json) references dist/tasks/autopilot-resume-smoke.js whose SOURCE was deleted in an earlier Authority-retirement cleanup commit — the script fails with a missing-file error. Pre-existing issue found in passing during story B-70e9 (2026-07-10, implementer report). Remove or repoint the stale script via the Lattice story workflow (small chore story).
normalizedOutcome: packages/main/package.json no longer defines a test:autopilot-resume-smoke script pointing at the deleted dist/tasks/autopilot-resume-smoke.js, so npm scripts in packages/main all resolve to real buildable entry points and the missing-file failure can no longer occur.
acceptanceClaim: In a clean story worktree, npm --prefix packages/main run lists no test:autopilot-resume-smoke entry and a repo-wide grep finds no runnable reference to autopilot-resume-smoke outside historical story artifacts and the decision-doc evidence row.
